answer_1.quote: This work focuses on algorithms for detecting machine-generated text via watermarked generation-adding signatures during text generation which are algorithmically detectable, yet are imperceptible to human eye.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate generation quality, we measure the perplexity (PPL) with OPT-2.7B. Generation diversity is measured with trigram text entropy (Ent-3)... We also evaluate generations with Sem-Ent...
